title: abatty.config.json
description: The one configuration of a repository under abatty: what the hooks trust (the gate command, the files, the push policy, the phases), the ratchet, the scrub, the provenance, the rules. At the repository root; the older place, .claude/adoption.json, is still read and the root file wins key by key.

profiles.description: The profiles this repository follows, in order: a built-in id (synovitec), a file (./profiles/acme.mjs) or an installed package exporting a profile (rules, phases, presets, harness rule files as one package). ["synovitec"] when absent; a client project names only its own.

workspaces.description: The preset of a workspace folder when its dependencies do not say (`"apps/web": "next"`). Each workspace with a preset is gated in its own folder by that preset's steps; the repository-level steps run once at the root.

stage.description: Where the repository is: design (documents, decisions, a schema, a mockup; no application yet), build, or run (serving users, a deploy surface). Read from the tree when absent; a rule of another stage is n/a with the stage named.

stack.description: The preset this repository runs: next, vite-react, node.

baseBranch.description: The branch a night starts from and the Stop gate reads the config from.

directPushToBase.description: true for an internal platform that pushes to the base after the gate; false for a PR-only project. A night never pushes to the base.

commands.description: The repository's own commands, as the hooks and the runner call them.

files.description: Where the changelog, the version, the night's state, the decisions, the progress log and the baseline live.

standard.description: The standard's document, for the agents to read.

plan.description: The adoption plan, for the agents to read.

changelogRequiredFor.description: Path prefixes whose commits must carry a changelog line.

coupled.description: Coupled paths: when this changes, that changes in the same push. Judged per commit over the pushed range by the ratchet (the gate, CI) and the Stop hook; a `when` path changed without a `then` path after it is refused until a later commit touches it. A schema and its migration, an API and its client, a document and the code it describes.

when.description: A prefix or a glob (* a segment, ** any depth).

protectedPaths.description: Paths a night never writes: applied migrations, env files, production compose.

mcpServers.description: The MCP servers a night may call; every other server's tools are denied.

waived.description: Rule ID to a reason, or to { reason, until }.

hard.description: Metrics held at zero whatever the probe says.

ratchet.description: Metrics held as a ratchet even at zero (never promoted to hard).

enabled.description: Off unless set: provenance is the default.

allow.description: Path substrings whose lines are not findings.

trailer.description: A disclosure line every unattended commit carries; empty for none.

allow.description: Path substrings the secret scan skips (fixtures, samples), with the reason beside them.

providers.description: The CI providers abatty ci generates for, from the gate; init writes them too.

phases.description: The phases a night walks, in order.

allowance.description: What a night may spend, in the unit the account is billed in: dollars for metered access; sessions or tokens under a subscription, where the dollar figure is a proxy. Any cap reached ends the night. Without one, 60 USD.

sandbox.description: The OS boundary under the guard for a night: the tree writable, the harness, the root config and the protected paths read-only, the rest of the machine read-only. Built by the runner and proven by a probe before the first session.

mode.description: auto: a driver found on the machine, else the guard alone (said loudly); required: no driver, no night; off: never.

driver.description: Name a driver instead of detecting one: bubblewrap (Linux), sandbox-exec (macOS), a container image.

command.description: The driver's executable when it is not on the PATH (or the container engine: docker, podman).

image.description: A container image carrying the agent and a Node; naming one selects the container driver.

readOnly.description: More paths read-only inside the boundary.

writable.description: Paths outside the tree a session may write (a cache, a tool's state folder).

env.description: The variables a container passes through, by name.

home.description: The container's HOME, where the agent's state folder is mounted (default /root).
